observations.body: Work, opposition, vision, and judgment in Corinth. After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth. Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

payload.posture: Read Acts 18:1–17 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states work, opposition, vision, and judgment in Corinth. After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth. Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
